slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
季月睁眼秒穿。
上一瞬，她才因为过于抽象在客厅四肢并用的乱爬吓到亲戚，父母把她强制送到精神病院，进行电击疗法。
下一秒就到了陌生的修仙世界。
同时脑海响起冷硬机械的声音：
【欢迎绑定直播大女主系统，宿主任务：让观众爽，赢得观众打赏。】
【打赏的礼物会在每场直播结束自动兑换成人民币，以现金的方式发放至宿主银行卡。】
季月：？
提到钱，季月就坦然接受了草率的穿越和绑定的系统。
霎时间，陌生的世界背景知识带着排江倒海之势强制灌入她的脑海，脑子快被撑爆的痛楚让她忍不住捂着头痛苦呻吟。
半晌，那些东西几经磨合，缓缓平息下来，彻底融入她的记忆。
这里是一个绝对崇尚修仙的世界，皇帝都得往后靠。
原主与季月同名，身在修仙五大宗的第一大宗——天山宗，她是宗主祝徵座下唯一女弟子，可以想象她的好日子有多好。
日常就是摆烂，修仙什么的根本不存在，天天对师兄弟们左拥右抱，还有想要巴结天山宗的人给原主送貌美的男人。
宗主祝徵又对原主溺爱纵容，向来都是睁一只眼闭一只眼，整个天山宗，可以说有几分姿色的男人，都和原主传出过风流韵事。
若不是祝徵修的无情道，原主也想跟她师尊有一段。
季月捂嘴痛哭流涕，趴在地上，一锤一锤的锤击地面。
这简直——太好了！
不就是当女主让观众爽吗，这还不手拿把掐。
尤其是还有钱赚！
“季师姐，你受什么刺激了？”

“沈师弟又惹你生气了？师姐，要我说，不如你看看我们几个？我们可舍不得你生气。”
路过的师弟瞧见季月匍匐在地上，疯狂敲打地面，纷纷上前关切的问道。
季月闻言抬起头。
哇塞。
几个围着她的师弟，都是个顶个的帅哥，目测平均身高一八五。
她矫揉造作的伸出手臂，让师弟们将她从地上拉起来，她顺势近距离欣赏起师弟们的颜值。
师弟们个个挺直了腰背，身材挺括，可以联想到衣料下令人感叹的肌肉轮廓。
季月发出啧啧声：“一个个，真俊啊。”
忽然，一道带着怒意的男声在她身后响起：
“季月！你昨晚还说最爱我，你转头就挑上了，所以你说的那些承诺算什么！”
季月转过身去，不远处长廊下的男子，让她眼眸一亮。
哪怕和师兄弟们都是穿着一样浅白的弟子服，他却穿得别有风味，静静伫立着，仿佛周身隔绝尘世喧嚣，晨光透过花枝，在他衣袍上投下斑驳光影。
眉眼间还有几分少年的稚气，此刻眼中满是对季月的哀怨。
季月脑中快速闪过此人的信息，原主最近一直穷追不舍的小师弟沈宴。
同时，季月的眼前的飘过零星的弹幕：
content_en:
Ji Yue opened her eyes and instantly passed through.
Just a moment ago, she scared her relatives by crawling around the living room on all fours because she was too abstract, and her parents forced her to a mental hospital for electroshock therapy.
The next second he arrived in the unfamiliar world of cultivating immortals.
At the same time, a cold and mechanical voice sounded in my mind:
[Welcome to bind to the live broadcast heroine system, the host’s mission: to make the audience happy and win rewards from the audience. 】
[The rewards will be automatically converted into RMB at the end of each live broadcast and distributed to the host’s bank card in cash. 】
Ji Yue:?
When it comes to money, Ji Yue calmly accepts the hasty time travel and binding system.
In an instant, the unfamiliar background knowledge of the world was forced into her mind with overwhelming force. The pain of her brain being about to burst made her cover her head and moan in pain.
After a while, those things slowly calmed down and were completely integrated into her memory.
This is a world that absolutely advocates cultivating immortals, and the emperor has to stand back.
The original owner has the same name as Ji Yue. She belongs to the Tianshan Sect, the first of the five major sects of immortality. She is the only female disciple of the sect leader Zhu Zheng. You can imagine how good her life is.
His daily life is just showing off, there is no such thing as cultivating immortals, he hugs his brothers and sisters every day, and he also wants to curry favor with people from the Tianshan Sect and sends beautiful men to his original owner.
The sect leader Zhu Zheng doted on and indulged the original lord, and always turned a blind eye. In the entire Tianshan Sect, it could be said that there were some pretty men who had affairs with the original lord.
If it weren't for Zhu Zhengxiu's ruthless ways, the original owner would have wanted to have a relationship with her master.
Ji Yue covered her mouth and cried bitterly, lying on the ground, hammering the ground with hammer after hammer.
This is simply - great!
Isn't it just that being the heroine makes the audience happy?
Especially when there is money to be made!
"Senior Sister Ji, what aroused you?"
"Junior Brother Shen made you angry again? Senior sister, why don't you take a look at some of us? We can't bear to make you angry."
The junior brothers who were passing by saw Ji Yue crawling on the ground, beating the ground crazily, and they all stepped forward and asked with concern.
Ji Yue raised her head when she heard the words.
Wow.
The few junior brothers surrounding her were all very handsome guys, with an average height of 185 by visual inspection.
She stretched out her arms in a pretentious manner and asked her junior brothers to pull her up from the ground. She took advantage of the situation to admire their looks at close range.
The juniors all straightened their backs and had straight bodies, which can be thought of as the impressive muscle outlines under the clothes.
Ji Yue clicked her tongue: "They are all so handsome."
Suddenly, an angry male voice sounded behind her:
"Ji Yue! You said you loved me the most last night, and you turned around and picked me, so those promises you mentioned are nothing!"
Ji Yue turned around and saw the man in the corridor not far away, which made her eyes brighten.
Even though he was wearing the same light white disciple uniform as his fellow disciples, he was dressed in a unique way. He stood quietly, as if he was isolated from the hustle and bustle of the world. The morning light filtered through the flower branches, casting mottled light and shadow on his robe.
There is still a bit of childishness between the eyebrows and eyes, but at this moment, the eyes are full of sorrow for Ji Yue.
Information about this person flashed through Ji Yue's mind. The original owner was Shen Yan, his junior brother who had been chasing after him recently.
